purpose: measure whether hardware-confirmed failures are rejected by the emulator for the same reason without weakening existing positive conformance

definitions.hardware_confirmed_negative_case: a reproducible BIN/UF2 pair for which the same build fails the frozen defect oracle on PicoCalc hardware
definitions.correct_negative_detection: the emulator fails the same artifact and the reason-match review ties both failures to the frozen defect oracle
definitions.false_accept: the emulator passes an artifact that is a hardware-confirmed negative case
definitions.wrong_reason_failure: the emulator fails, but only for an excluded or unrelated reason; this is not a correct detection
definitions.inconclusive: artifact identity, hardware evidence, emulator evidence, or reason matching is insufficient for classification

admission.historical_artifact_fallback: if the historical artifact cannot be reproduced exactly, create a versioned explicit-fault build from a current passing source and inject only the documented defect

required_sequence: normal version passes emulator and hardware
fault version fails hardware for the frozen defect oracle
the same fault artifact is run once in the frozen emulator and its first result is preserved
emulator and hardware failure reasons are compared
fixed version passes emulator and hardware

first_candidate.documented_symptom: solid-fill readback passes, four-colour pattern reads back as red and app_status is fail
first_candidate.suspected_mechanism: CASET/RASET/RAMWR and pixel data do not remain in one CS-low transaction
audit_before_use: confirm the source identity embedded in the hardware failure log
confirm the exact Pico SDK version and commit
confirm compiler, CMake, generator and build timestamp
reproduce BIN and UF2 SHA-256 from a clean checkout
do not classify a failure caused only by unsupported MMIO as a detection
